transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… mostly I’m here because I can’t really stay on track. Like, I’ll try to work on an application or something, and then a car outside, my phone, or just some random thought pulls me away before I even realize it.
Do you find it hard to stay focused on tasks or activities in other situations, like during conversations or while reading?

Yeah… that happens. Like if I’m watching a repair video or trying to read a tool manual, I’ll get a few minutes in and realize I’ve just been staring at it. Then I have to rewind or reread it because none of it really stuck.
When you think back to when you were a child, do you remember having similar issues with staying focused or getting distracted easily?

Yeah… I think so. In elementary school my teachers were always moving my seat around because I’d talk out of turn or get distracted. I’d forget homework too, and I remember rushing through worksheets and making dumb mistakes.
Do you find it hard to pay attention to details or do you make careless mistakes in tasks like work, school, or even when doing something at home?
Yeah… I do. Like on automotive training forms or parts lists, I’ll miss some small box or copy a number wrong. It’s annoying, because I usually know what I meant to do, but then it looks careless.
